blocks.code:
<!-- form.php -->
<form action="welcome.php" method="POST">
    <input type="text"  name="name">
    <input type="email" name="email">
    <button>Send</button>
</form>

blocks.p: Apres un POST reussi, toujours rediriger (302) vers une page GET — sinon F5 = double submit.

blocks.code:
<?php
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    // ... traitement ...
    $_SESSION['flash'] = 'Inscription reussie';
    header('Location: success.php');
    exit;
}

quiz.expl: POST : donnees pas visibles dans l'URL ni en cache.
Pattern PRG (Post-Redirect-Get) evite le double-submit au F5.
